kudos-sunners.ts imports kudos-data.ts type-only, so the runtime module cycle and its TDZ crash stay closed
pnpm build regenerates all 10 routes including /kudos

findings.summary: submit revoked the blob URLs it had just handed to the new feed post, blanking thumbnails on the just-sent kudos; fixed by splitting clear() (discard, revokes) from detach() (submit, transfers URL ownership)

Escape inside any nested dropdown bubbled to the modal's document-level handler and discarded the whole draft; fixed by consuming Escape in the capture phase, since both listeners sit on document and the dialog's registers first
same Escape data-loss path via the mention popup and the link-URL prompt; both now stop the event locally and the mention list gained ArrowUp/Down/Enter/Tab/Escape navigation

author-supplied editor HTML is stored unsanitised in KudosPost.content; inert today because the feed flattens it via htmlToText and no dangerouslySetInnerHTML exists, but sanitisation is required before any kudos-detail screen renders it as HTML
link-URL prompt has no outside-click dismiss (Escape and its confirm button both work), and aria-activedescendant is not applied across the four dropdowns

no live browser visual-diff was possible: /kudos is behind Supabase auth and no browser-automation tool was available, so visual fidelity rests on MoMorph node data plus a reference-PNG comparison; a Playwright pass against an authenticated session is still owed
